category.title: ActionScript 3
category.description: Tracked families of language features and Flash APIs. The completed share of this registry is not a percentage of Flash Player compatibility.

features.title: Source diagnostics
features.scope: Parse errors and unsupported frontend constructs report the language, line and column; compilation errors block export.
features.limitations: This guarantees compiler diagnostics, not verification of every Flash API semantic.

features.title: Literals
features.scope: Decimal, hexadecimal and exponent numbers; strings; Boolean, null, undefined, NaN and Infinity; arrays without holes and object literals.
features.limitations: The full set of literals and historical Flash rules is not implemented; legacy numbers with leading zeroes are rejected.

features.title: Variables and scope
features.scope: var, multiple declarations, handler-owner fields, and hoisting of local var declarations and parameters.
features.limitations: Handler fields differ from classes and the full Flash scope chain; top-level declarations follow documented reinitialization rules.

features.title: Arithmetic, logic and assignments
features.scope: Basic arithmetic, comparisons, short-circuit evaluation, bitwise operations, ++/-- and compound assignments.
features.limitations: Some operations use JavaScript coercion; this is not complete AVM semantics across all Flash Player versions.

features.title: If/else branches
features.scope: Parsing and execution of if/else, blocks and the conditional expression ?:, selecting one branch.
features.limitations: This covers control flow in the supported frontend; conversion of arbitrary Flash objects remains part of unfinished type compatibility.

features.title: Classic loops and jumps
features.scope: while, do/while, three-part for, and nested break/continue with jump-target validation.
features.limitations: for..in property enumeration and full compatibility of condition coercion are tracked separately.

features.title: Switch and fallthrough
features.scope: Single evaluation of the subject, sequential case matching, default, fallthrough and break.
features.limitations: The supported contract uses strict comparison; compatibility across Flash Player versions is not certified.

features.title: Function declarations and calls
features.scope: Function declarations and expressions, recursion, mutual recursion, return, callbacks and immediately invoked function expressions.
features.limitations: Declarations must be directly inside a function or handler body; general dynamic method lookup and cross-script symbol resolution are absent.

features.title: Closures and variable capture
features.scope: Lexical local variables, shadowing, closures retained after return, and capture of the handler owner.
features.limitations: The complete Flash receiver, global-object and scope-chain models are not implemented.

features.title: Function parameters and returns
features.scope: Positional parameters, exact argument counts, selected typed arguments/returns and return-path validation.
features.limitations: Default/rest parameters, arguments and general Function.call/apply are absent; full compatibility of types and invocation errors is unproven.

features.title: this and method binding
features.scope: this refers to the handler owner; AS3 functions declared at handler level retain their owner when detached.
features.limitations: Explicit this in AS2 functions, nested declarations and function expressions is rejected; general receiver behavior is not implemented.

features.title: Annotations and type system
features.scope: Selected Number/int/uint/Boolean/String/Function/Error/* defaults and coercion for bare-name writes, arguments and returns.
features.limitations: There is no complete type checker, user-defined class model or typed instance-slot model; this.field writes and writes from another handler do not enforce the declared type.

features.title: Throw, catch and finally
features.scope: Throw, ordered catches for selected types, separate catch scopes, finally and abrupt-completion precedence.
features.limitations: Catches for arbitrary classes/interfaces, boxed-primitive equivalence and complete AVM2 error mapping are absent.

features.title: Error objects
features.scope: A limited set of core Error constructors, message, name, errorID and toString.
features.limitations: General class construction, getStackTrace, complete prototype semantics and all Flash error codes are absent.

features.title: Classes, inheritance and interfaces
features.scope: A complete model of class/interface, extends/implements, members, super, getters/setters and general new.
features.limitations: These constructs are rejected by the frontend; the Error facade does not implement arbitrary classes.

features.title: Imports and project linking
features.scope: package/import, document classes, linkage and cross-file resolution.
features.limitations: The current compilation unit is an individual synchronous frame or object handler.

features.title: Dynamic objects and prototypes
features.scope: Object literals, custom fields, property/index reads and explicitly defined function members.
features.limitations: There is no complete Object/prototype/scope-chain model; computed calls, general alias/type inference and some dynamic methods are rejected.

features.title: Property enumeration and with
features.scope: for..in enumeration and correct name lookup inside with.
features.limitations: These are unsupported; a classic three-part for loop does not implement property enumeration.

features.title: Additional language operators
features.scope: is, as, instanceof, in, delete, unary void and general new.
features.limitations: These are rejected with diagnostics; the separate new Error facade does not complete this capability.

features.title: Primitives and global conversions
features.scope: Number, String, Boolean, parseInt, parseFloat, isNaN and isFinite are available through JavaScript.
features.limitations: Flash-specific and version-specific rules, boxed values and the complete standard library are not implemented.

features.title: Math
features.scope: A closed list of numeric Math methods, including trigonometry, abs, min/max, pow, random and round.
features.limitations: Execution is delegated to JavaScript; the full contract and numerical equivalence with Flash are not certified.

features.title: Array, String and Number methods
features.scope: Selected push/pop/shift/unshift/join/slice/indexOf/substring/charAt/charCodeAt/toString/toFixed/split/concat/reverse methods.
features.limitations: The list is limited and uses JavaScript behavior, with possible differences in ranges, coercion and errors.

features.title: Trace through the browser host
features.scope: trace from handlers and nested functions runs through the host, updating the console and player status line.
features.limitations: This implements the observable NeoFlash output channel; complete formatting of all Flash types is not claimed.

features.title: MovieClip and timelines
features.scope: play/stop, gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop, nextFrame/prevFrame, current/total frames, named children and independent nested clocks.
features.limitations: This is a limited MovieClip facade; complete construction/re-entry, scenes, dynamic display lists and the Flash lifecycle are not implemented.

features.title: Display properties
features.scope: x/y, rotation, alpha, scaleX/scaleY and root/parent through a limited host facade.
features.limitations: The complete DisplayObject API, visible, width/height, mask and filters are absent; arbitrary custom fields do not prove a change to the rendered image.

features.title: Events and handlers
features.scope: Authored frame scripts and load/click/enter_frame object events; target-lifetime checks and a limit on recursive dispatch.
features.limitations: The complete Flash event model, keyboard/mouse APIs, button states and compatible ordering of all lifecycle events are absent.

features.title: Programmatic drawing
features.scope: flash.display.Graphics, BitmapData and programmatic Flash graphics.
features.limitations: Authored vector shapes and their Canvas rendering do not provide a Graphics API callable from ActionScript.

features.title: TextField and text APIs
features.scope: Dynamic and input text, formatting, measurement, selection and programmatic TextField control.
features.limitations: Static text in the document model does not implement Flash TextField; a custom field named text does not change the rendered string.

features.title: Audio, video and resource loading
features.scope: Flash media APIs, loading of images, audio and video, playback control and synchronization.
features.limitations: The authoring/runtime model does not yet provide the corresponding ActionScript APIs.

features.title: Networking, storage and external communication
features.scope: Flash networking/loaders, SharedObject and explicitly defined browser bridges.
features.limitations: JavaScript access to the browser does not imply support for equivalent ActionScript APIs.

features.title: Components and platform libraries
features.scope: Flash/Flex components and applicable AIR/platform APIs, with separate browser adaptations.
features.limitations: These libraries are not implemented; porting platform APIs requires an explicit supported/adapted/unavailable contract.

features.title: Complete virtual-machine semantics
features.scope: AVM2 compatibility, including types, classes, coercion and runtime errors.
features.limitations: The current frontend emits JavaScript; internal regression tests are not Flash Player conformance certification.

features.title: Debugger and source maps
features.scope: ActionScript debugging with original source lines, breakpoints and state inspection.
features.limitations: Compile/publish diagnostics exist; a complete source debugger is absent.

features.title: Labels and named jumps
features.scope: Statement labels, labelled break and continue to outer loops, with function-boundary validation.
features.limitations: This status covers AS3 source control flow, not MovieClip frame labels.

features.title: Namespaces, XML and E4X
features.scope: namespace/use namespace, qualified names, XML/XMLList, E4X and for each.
features.limitations: These are rejected by the frontend; XFL XML parsing does not implement AS3 XML.

features.title: Vector, Dictionary and ByteArray
features.scope: Typed collections, dictionaries, binary buffers and related AS3 APIs.
features.limitations: Ordinary JavaScript arrays and objects do not replace these contracts.
